title: Coffee-break SOC2 notes — Amira
content:
Quick coffee-break dump — SOC2 evidence & small TODOs (non-blocking)

09:12 AM — brain dump
- Top of mind: vendor questionnaire from Percepta still missing crypto key rotation section.
- Quick sanity check items to track today:
  - [ ] confirm KMS rotation evidence for prod (who: infra, where: s3/archive/kms-rotations/)
  - [ ] ask SRE to export access revocation log for last 6 months (PR reference infra#234)
  - [ ] scan vendor contracts folder for CCPA/CNIL clauses (target: 2026-06-10)

Notes to self / fragments:
- Percepta Q: they sent a short-form questionnaire on 2026-05-28; appendix B (key mgmt) blank. Slack thread #vendor-percepta has threads from Priya re: PO.
- Evidence idea: snapshot of KMS key policy + rotation cronjob (cron name: key-rotate-prod) + screenshots of console > logs. Prefer to collect both console screenshot + exported CSV for audit.
- Quick check on S3 policies: need to pull the bucket policy for redwood-prod-evidence and redwood-backups; ensure no public flag. TODO: list buckets and tag owner.

Vendor review quick checklist (Percepta / Nimbus / SecureBridge):
- Last security assessment date? (Percepta: 2025-11-04 — ask for more recent)
- SOC2/ISO attestation present? (Percepta: only ISO pending)
- Data flows: do they touch PII? -> yes, limited. Add to data map.
- Contractual language re: subprocessors and incident SLA.

Small process improvements to try (blue-sky, jotting):
- Keep a single evidence bucket structure: /evidence/<control>/<type>/<YYYY-MM-DD>
- When asking for logs, request: "CSV export + raw gzipped log" to faciliate automated ingestion later.
- Short template for vendor questionnaires so we can forward to them: one-pager with 6 golden fields (attestation, crypto, backups, retention, incident response, subprocessors).

Immediate next actions (today):
- ping SRE (Noah) in Slack for access revocations export — tag: SEC-412 — ETA EOD
- create minimal evidence folder for Percepta (me) and upload current artifacts (screen grabs + email thread) — ETA tomorrow morning
- drop quick note to Legal (Leah) re: contract clause gap on incident SLA, ask for a redline suggestion

Random friction notes (to resolve later):
- Some control IDs in Confluence don't match our naming convention (e.g., CC-7 vs CC7). Might break script if we automate ingestion. Log to product-ops.
- Retention policy wording unclear for ephemeral tokens — doc: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/SEC/Token-Retention (need consolidated owner)

Questions to follow up (short):
- Do we accept vendor self-attestation or require third-party for critical vendors (> $50k)? (ask Priya / Legal)
- For KMS rotation proof, is a screenshot enough for auditor or do they want hashed history entries? (ask auditor contact: aud-contact@redwood-audit.com)

Personal tickler (brainstorm):
- If we standardize evidence file names (controlID_vendor_date_type.ext) then we can write a tiny lambda to index and generate the control matrix automatically. 2-3 day spike. Good candidate for a small infra ticket.

End of coffee-break dump. Will clean up and push to "evidence/percepta/" later.

-- Amira
